name: What is the process for getting an estimate for a guest bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting an estimate for a guest bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for getting an estimate typically starts with contacting City Dweller, LLC to schedule an initial consultation. During this meeting, we will discuss your vision, budget, desired features, and assess the existing bathroom space. We'll ask about your preferences for materials, finishes, and any functional changes you're considering. Following this, our team will develop a detailed proposal that outlines the scope of work, material selections, and a transparent cost breakdown. This comprehensive estimate ensures you have a clear understanding of the project before any work begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: To get an estimate, contact us for an initial consultation to discuss your vision and budget. We will then provide a detailed proposal outlining the scope of work and a transparent cost breakdown.
